words.name: technique-effects
words.spec: Technique `effects` list (`{"name": <Effect>, "unlock_layer": n, "passive_art": true, "rule": ...}`) attached by fight.py / FighterCompiler when layer >= unlock_layer.
words.decision_reason: Already approved in thien_xu checkpoint (2026-11-27). Both green-furnace-canon (d5 the-furnace-spills-over) and empty-mountain-sutra (d5 the-empty-mountains-answer) attach The Empty Mountain's Answer via `effects`; the runtime Effect itself lives in effects/thuy_vi.effects.json so tv-green-moss-mirror also runs it today.

words.name: heal-overflow
words.spec: In engine.py heal() (line 1593), emit `heal_restored` (or `heal_overflow`) with `overflow=amount - got` even when `s.hp == top` (`got == 0`, `amount > 0`), including pulse health regeneration or explicit over-heals, so effects listening on full-HP wasted healing receive every overflow tick.
words.gdd_text: The Empty Mountain's Answer (d5): healing lost to your full health is stored as Green and falls every 3 s.
words.decision_reason: Today engine.py line 1593 only raises `heal_restored` when `got > 0`, so healing cast at 100% HP raises nothing and only partial overshoots raise `event.overflow`. Adding a 2-line emit when `amount > got` lets The Empty Mountain's Answer run faithfully at full health. Until built, effects/thuy_vi.effects.json runs its `heal_restored` `event.overflow` half and logs this gap in `approx`.
